notes.title: Patch 2023-12-01 : adjust gamepad sensitivity + saving settings
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

You can now adjust the sensitivity of the gamepad axis and the gamepad buttons threshold.

You can save and restore the settings of the game :

[list]
[*] video mode
[*] sounds and music level
[*] gamepad sensitivity
[/list]

the saved settings are automatically restore at the launch

notes.title: Patch 2023-04-01 : Fix Crash, crash at Launch, Freezing Issues.
notes.content:
Fix Crash, crash at Launch, Freezing Issues, and significantly reduces loading time.

(A bad texture's management caused Fps drops or worse some game crashing, especialy on small configs)

This patch should fix the problem.

Nevertheless, some sprites may appear uggly (squared) at the start of the game, but that will disappear by itself very quickly. (will be fixed in the next update)

My apologies for the bad gameplay experience.
